summary: Apple-style morphism effects and animations testing completed successfully. All 9 requested features pass. The full UX overhaul includes glassmorphism effects, animated counters, staggered reveal animations, morphing navbar, animated dropdowns, product card hover effects, mobile bottom navigation, mobile drawer, and theme toggle across desktop and mobile.

features_tested.feature: Hero section has animated text reveal (ENGINEERING / BRILLIANCE)
features_tested.details: Hero title shows 'ENGINEERING BRILLIANCE' with Framer Motion animated text reveal. ENGINEERING in white, BRILLIANCE with cyan gradient.

features_tested.feature: Stats section uses glassmorphism cards with animated counters
features_tested.details: Found 4 glass-card elements with AnimatedCounter components. Stats animate when scrolled into view (640+, 252+, 320+, 4,560).

features_tested.feature: Product families section has staggered reveal animations
features_tested.details: Found 5 product family cards using StaggerContainer and StaggerItem components for sequential reveal animations.

features_tested.feature: Navbar has morphing effect on scroll (shrinks when scrolled)
features_tested.details: Navbar padding changes from 12px to 8.7px when scrolling. Background becomes more opaque and adds shadow on scroll.

features_tested.feature: Dropdown menus have fade/scale animation on open/close
features_tested.details: Products dropdown uses Framer Motion AnimatePresence with scale and opacity animation on hover.

features_tested.feature: Product cards have lift and glow effect on hover
features_tested.details: Product cards use motion.div with whileHover={{ y: -8, scale: 1.02, boxShadow: ... }} for lift and glow effects.
All 5 nav items (Home, Products, Solutions, Contact, More) visible and functional. Navigation between pages works.

features_tested.feature: Mobile drawer slides in from right with smooth animation
features_tested.details: Drawer uses Framer Motion with initial={{ x: '100%' }} and spring animation (damping: 30, stiffness: 300).

features_tested.feature: Theme toggle works in both desktop and mobile
features_tested.details: Desktop theme toggle in navbar works. Mobile has theme toggle in header and in drawer. Both correctly switch between dark/light modes.

critical_code_review_comments: AppleAnimations.js: Well-structured reusable animation components (ScrollReveal, StaggerContainer, GlassCard, MagneticButton, etc.) using Framer Motion.
apple-design.css: Comprehensive CSS design system with glassmorphism classes, Apple-style springs/easing, and prefers-reduced-motion support.
Home.js: Properly imports and uses animation components. MorphingShape adds floating shapes for visual depth.
Navbar.js: Uses useEffect with scroll listener and Framer Motion animate for morphing header effect.
MobileDrawer.js: Clean implementation with AnimatePresence for enter/exit animations and proper theme support.
Products.js: ProductCard component uses motion.div with hover animations for lift and glow effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Apple-style UX overhaul is complete and working. Key animation components are in AppleAnimations.js. Design system CSS is in apple-design.css. All animations use Framer Motion with Apple-style easing curves. Mobile experience includes bottom navigation bar and slide-in drawer from right.
